title: adbridge/v1 — bridge → backend envelope
description: Every message the autodarts-bridge sends to the backend over WSS. The `kind` field is the discriminator; `data` shape depends on it. Raw BM frames are forwarded separately as bm.frame. See diff-rules.md for how the bridge derives dart/takeout/visit events from consecutive BM state snapshots.

Segment.title: Board Manager segment
Segment.description: Exactly as Board Manager sends it. For Outside throws, multiplier=0 and score will be 0. Bull 25: bed=Single, number=25. Bull 50: bed=Double, number=50 (unverified on hardware). Near-miss: name=M<n>, number=n, bed=Outside. Bounce-out: name=Miss, number=0, bed=Outside.

Coords.title: Normalised board coordinates
Coords.description: Bull-centred, r=1.0 at the outer double wire, x pointing right, y pointing up. Values beyond r=1 are valid for near-misses. Absent on bounce-outs (bed=Outside, name=Miss).

Polar.title: Polar coordinates (bridge-computed)
Polar.description: Derived from coords. r=1 at the outer double wire. theta_deg measured counterclockwise from the positive x-axis (right). Only present when coords is present.

Dart.title: A detected dart
Dart.description: coords and polar are absent for bounce-outs (bed=Outside, name=Miss). bouncer is true only for bounce-outs. score = segment.number × segment.multiplier; always 0 for Outside throws.

bouncer.description: True when the dart hit a wire or the board and bounced off. Only present (and true) on bounce-outs.

VisitId.description: ULID, unique per visit (the physical set of darts in the board between two takeouts).

BaseEnvelope.description: Fields present on every adbridge/v1 message.

v.description: Schema major version. Backend refuses an unknown major and tells the bridge to update.

boot_id.description: New UUID every time the bridge process starts.

seq.description: Increases monotonically per boot_id. Backend dedupes on (bridge_id, boot_id, seq).

board_id.description: auth.board_id from /api/config. Bridge refuses to send if this changes.

recv_wall.description: UTC wall-clock timestamp when the BM frame arrived at the bridge.

recv_mono_ns.description: Nanoseconds since the bridge process started (monotonic). Use only for durations within one boot_id.

kind.description: Event discriminator. See oneOf variants below.

BridgeHelloData.description: Sent once on connect, before any seq-numbered events.

BmLinkData.description: Board Manager WebSocket connection went up or down.

BmFrameData.description: Every raw Board Manager frame, forwarded verbatim (except auth frames, which are dropped). Secrets (api_key, token) are never forwarded. The raw BM payload is in the top-level `raw` field.

source.description: ws = arrived via WebSocket push; poll = arrived via GET /api/state.

BoardStatusData.description: Fired when status, event, or running changes. connected is forwarded as-is but documented as unreliable (can be false while detection is live).

status.description: BM status string. Known values: Offline, Starting, Running, Stopping, Stopped, Throw, Takeout, Takeout in progress, Calibrating, Setup, Error. Treat as open enum.

event.description: BM event string, free text. Known values: Throw detected, Takeout started, Takeout finished, Manual reset, Started, Stopped, etc.

connected.description: Unreliable. Has been seen as false while detection is active. Ignore for liveness; use running and status instead.

BoardResyncData.description: Emitted after any reconnect to Board Manager or to the backend. throws is the current board state — a baseline, NOT new darts. Consumers must not score these. The backend uses this to detect darts that landed during a gap (R5) and asks the user.

VisitOpenedData.description: Emitted with the first dart.detected of a new visit (when throws goes from 0 to 1).

DartDetectedData.description: A new dart appeared at throws[index]. Emitted after visit.opened if this is the first dart of a visit.

source_seq.description: seq of the bm.frame that triggered this event.

DartCorrectedData.description: throws[index] changed segment between two consecutive state frames. The bridge refolds the open visit from committedState; game authors write only forward-only reducers.

DartMovedData.description: throws[index] kept the same segment but coords changed by more than ε=0.02. Only games that use coordinates care about this event.

TakeoutStartedData.description: Takeout motion has begun. trigger identifies what caused the bridge to emit this.

TakeoutFinishedData.description: All darts have been removed (numThrows=0). duration_ms is measured from takeout.started.

VisitClearedData.description: numThrows dropped to 0 without a detected takeout — typically a POST /api/reset or a Manual reset event from the BM.

MotionData.description: motion_state frame forwarded from Board Manager. High-rate; consumers may throttle.

CommandResultData.description: Result of a downstream command (reset, start, stop) sent by the backend.

http_status.description: HTTP status from the BM endpoint, if applicable.

raw.description: Exact BM JSON frame, verbatim. Secrets are redacted.
